sentences: First j is 0, compare 3 and 2, so swap them and get 2,3,1. Then j is 1, compare 3 and 1, swap again, giving 1,2,3.
At j equals 0 the 3 and 2 trade places. At j equals 1 the 3 moves past 1, so after going through the loop both times everything is in order.
I followed j from 0 to 1 and did every comparison inside the loop, swapping whenever the left number was bigger, and ended up with 1,2,3.
The loop runs j=0 then j=1. Comparing a[0] with a[1] swaps, then a[1] with a[2] swaps, and after the full pass the whole thing looks sorted to me.
Starting with 3,2,1, the first check swaps 3 and 2, the next check swaps 3 and 1, and because the loop covers both j values the array becomes 1,2,3 at the end.
